## Expense / Receipt Logging

**Flow:** Gmail Trigger (receipts watch) → Split Attachments → [Has File? IF]
  • file branch: Move Binary Data (base64) → Google Drive Upload → Attach Drive Link
  • text branch: straight through (no attachment — uses the email body)
Both branches converge at Build Gemini Request → Gemini (vision/text extraction) → Parse & Build Row → Google Sheets Append → Slack Confirmation → Gmail: Mark Processed.

**Before activating:**
1. Credentials: Gmail (trigger + label), Google Drive, Google Sheets, Gemini (PaLM) API, Slack.
2. `Gmail Trigger`: set the filter query — default watches for `has:attachment` or `subject:(receipt OR expense)`. Adjust to a dedicated label/alias you forward receipts to.
3. `Google Drive: Upload Receipt`: pick a destination folder.
4. `Google Sheets: Append Row`: set the spreadsheet + sheet name. Create it first with these columns, in order: Date, Vendor, Amount, Currency, Category, Confidence, Notes, Status, Source, DriveLink, EmailSubject, EmailFrom, LoggedAt.
5. `Gmail: Mark Processed`: pick a label (e.g. "Receipts/Logged") from the dropdown — the placeholder ID won't work as-is.
6. `Slack: Send Confirmation`: confirm the channel.

**Note:** signature-logo images are soft-filtered by size but may occasionally slip through — delete stray sheet rows if that happens. Drive/Sheets node field names vary slightly by n8n version; if a param shows empty after import, reselect it from that field's dropdown.

filters.q: has:attachment OR subject:(receipt OR expense OR invoice)
